13.06.02

Bootloader and toolchain work !

Finally some real progress: I was able to boot a 'fake kernel' on my BE ! The 'fake kernel' is just the kernel startup code, and a few lines fiddling with the contrast/brightness settings of the LCD, compiled on my linux box with the cross-compile toolchain used to build a real kernel. When I boot it on my BE300 using my modified version of CyaCE (it's in CVS), the screen flickers as expected. so this proves both the bootloader and the toolchain work. (look in the 'Hackers' section if you want to try it yourself)

26.06.02

Linux Kernel booting

Thanks to Andrey for discovering the serial registers, I've been able to boot a Linux kernel on my BE300 ! Click here to see the bootlog. The latest version includes basic framebuffer support, so Tux is greeting you on the screen of your BE. You can download both source and pre-compiled binary in the 'kernel' section.
